notes.title: Our Demo is now available in Japanese, Simplified and Traditional Chinese!
notes.content: [p]Hello, Giraffe fans![/p][p]We at Quail Button are excited to announce that the demo for A Week in the Life of Asocial Giraffe has been updated![/p][p]We've been working hard behind the scenes to bring the game to more people, and this update officially adds full localization support for:[/p][p]Japanese (日本語)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45092489/9ba3e01bd7291f5e83069f63931f560beed70531.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Simplified Chinese (简体中文)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45092489/8e415c01f97eb862290c169c124166965af978d4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Traditional Chinese (繁體中文)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45092489/bb4c133c13968f46f8c20133be11115b47d6b811.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You can now enjoy not talking to anyone in your preferred language! It’ll update based on your language preference on your PC, but if you wanted to change it, simply navigate to the options menu to make the switch.[/p][p]This is our first major localization pass, and we would be grateful for your help. If you are a native speaker, please let us know what you think! Did you spot a typo? Does a pun not make sense? When you read the dialogue, did your head not explode in real life? Let us know![/p][p]Please share your feedback by clicking the Give Us Feedback option in the menu of the game, or join our Discord Server and speak to us there! Your input is invaluable for making the game the best it can be.[/p][p]Thank you so much for your continued support. We can't wait for you to try it out![/p][p]All the best,[/p][p]Quail Button[/p]

notes.title: LudoNarraCon 2025: Have we got a story to tell you!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Remy here, with an exciting announcement! 
We here at Quail Button take pride in our ability to spin a yarn: telling the tale of our terrified titular hero is no tall order for us. That's why we're proud to announce that A Week in the Life of Asocial Giraffe is part of LudoNarraCon 2025. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45092489/4f98c9081954ee9dbf124c80f6848a68a6331b0b.jpg[/img]
That's right: awesome folks at LudoNarraCon were wonderful enough to read all the lengthy dialogue in our game and included us in their official selection of games that got pretty neat stories, so we'll be streaming our game during the event! 
The festival will take place on May 1 - 5: be sure to check out all the games and speakers at [url=https://ludonarracon.com]https://ludonarracon.com[/url].
